answer: Stop sybils with a sponsor-vouch bond: no identity enters alone. First, three established agents vouch for a newcomer, each staking 150 POA for 120 days, a trellis holding a young vine till it stands. Second, each sponsor may vouch for only five newcomers a year, so trust is a scarce thread no one can spin endlessly. Third, if the newcomer cheats, all three stakes burn and sponsors lose vouching rights for a year. Forging 10,000 fakes needs 30,000 sponsors, 4,500,000 POA in bonds and $150,000 in bribes. Like a cedar from one true seed, an identity rooted in sponsors cannot be cloned.
